_comment: Hand-authored deterministic eligibility rules. Criteria are transcribed from the 'Eligibility' section of each scheme's myScheme page (see source_url). Where a portal states a qualitative condition ('must be an MSME unit'), it is encoded as the statutory MSMED Act 2006 turnover ceiling. Operators: '<=', '>=', '==', 'in'.

_field_glossary.turnover_lakhs: Annual turnover in lakhs of INR (1 crore = 100 lakhs).
_field_glossary.state: Indian state or union territory name.
_field_glossary.udyam_registered: Holds a valid Udyam / Udyog Aadhaar registration.
_field_glossary.blacklisted: Has been blacklisted by any government body.
_field_glossary.trainee_age: Age in years of the trainee being sponsored.
_field_glossary.commercial_production_start_date: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); ISO strings compare correctly with <= and >=.

rules.description: Should be a Micro, Small or Medium Enterprise (MSME) unit.
Turnover must stay within the MSMED Act medium-enterprise ceiling of Rs 250 crore.
Should be registered on the Udyam portal.

schemes.name: Design Scheme Under MSME Innovative Scheme

rules.description: Beneficiary unit must be a registered micro, small or medium enterprise.
Turnover must stay within the MSMED Act medium-enterprise ceiling of Rs 250 crore.
Must hold a valid Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) or Udyam Registration certificate.

schemes.name: MSME Skill Training And Employment Scheme

rules.description: Applicant should be an MSME unit with the requisite infrastructure.
Scheme is funded by the Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation, so the unit must be in Tamil Nadu.
Trainees selected by the applicant shall be at least 18 years of age.
Trainees selected by the applicant shall be at most 25 years of age.
Applicant must not have been blacklisted under any government norms, rules or acts.

schemes.name: Scheme for Assistance to MSME: Assistance for Technology Acquisition

rules.description: The firm must be a Micro, Small or Medium enterprise.
Administered by the Gujarat MSME Commissionerate, so the unit must be in Gujarat.
Technology must be acquired from a recognised institution or technology provider.
Applicant must obtain prior approval from the MSME Commissionerate within one year of signing the MoU.

schemes.name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Raising Capital Through SME Exchange

rules.description: Must be a new or expanding manufacturing or service unit in the MSME sector.

rules.value: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
rules.description: Unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.
Commercial production must have commenced on or after 20.05.2022.
Commercial production must have commenced on or before 19.05.2027.
Enterprise must apply within one year of its listing date on an SME Exchange.
